detail.longDescription: I love a good to-do list for my personal life. (Whether I actually follow that list and check things off in a timely manner is my own business.) And most of the joy of managing tasks, at least to my nerdy soul, is in using automation to make sure everything shows up in one place and keeps my brain clutter-free.
